concern_summary: This concern involves the management of held reports and expenses, including processing updates to reports and handling conditions related to payment requests.
This concern focuses on the approval processes related to held money requests and transactions, including managing hold statuses, and enabling user interactions for confirming or processing holds.
This concern centers on managing held expenses within reports, checking the status of transactions, and ensuring that appropriate actions can be taken based on the held status of expenses.

This concern encompasses functionalities that focus on the approval process of expense reports, including checking the status of a report, managing approval chains, and determining conditions under which reports can be approved or unheld.

This concern pertains to the handling of the default vendor associated with the report header. It includes the determination of the appropriate default vendor based on expense type (reimbursable or non-reimbursable) and the presentation of related information to users, aiding in understanding the vendor context.
This concern relates to the Money Report and its header management, ensuring that relevant status messages and action options are accurately rendered for users.
This concern deals with the evaluation and handling of expense reports, ensuring correct calculations, submissions, and management of associated actions throughout the expense reporting process.

This concern focuses on the financial management aspect of the IOU report, including updating total amounts based on transactions and creating corresponding expense reports to accurately reflect financial data.
